Vector DB market (the 'do you still need a dedicated vector DB' question got three answers in one day and none of them was yes - vectorless RAG where the data already carries enough structure, action-intent embeddings instead of lexical similarity, and the practitioner default landing on pgvector-until-it-hurts; RAGFlow is the only classical RAG engine still holding a trending slot)

Vector DB market under pressure (retrieval is collapsing back into the data platform — IBM Research builds filtered ANN out of Iceberg-style table-format pruning plus per-file indexes instead of a dedicated vector database, and SAP-Snowflake zero-copy reaches GA with CSN semantic views feeding Cortex Analyst and Cortex Code building agents on top without ETL; two independent moves against a bolt-on vector tier in one day)
